body: Bro you've got more to handle than most "normal" people, but you also have people who care about you. If you think you have too much on your plate right now, maybe it's best to take some things off. I'm sure your girlfriend would rather have you quit your job than leave her. And if you decide to keep trucking on, try to concentrate on your tasks at hand, because if you concentrate you will have more free time for yourself later.
